npcs.name: Kodlak Whitemane
npcs.greet: Jorrvaskr has stood longer than Whiterun's walls. We take work for coin and honor both, and we don't ask which a job pays in.

npcs.name: Aela the Huntress
npcs.greet: If you've come to stare, the training yard is around back. If you've come to hunt, talk to me.

npcs.name: Vilkas
npcs.greet: Another hopeful. Everyone wants to be a Companion until they learn what it costs.

npcs.name: Farkas
npcs.greet: Vilkas says I talk too much. I don't think so. Do you think so?

npcs.name: Skjor
npcs.greet: Keep your blade sharp and your questions short.

npcs.name: Eorlund Gray-Mane
npcs.greet: The Skyforge was old when the first Companions came. I only keep it fed.

relics.name: Vilkas's Sword
relics.desc: Notched from the training yard. Eorlund will know what to do with it.

relics.name: Fragment of Wuuthrad
relics.desc: A shard of Ysgramor's legendary axe, carried home across the sea.

relics.name: Glenmoril Witch Heads
relics.desc: Grim trophies. Kodlak believes burning them will free a soul from Hircine's hunt.

relics.name: Silver Hand Orders
relics.desc: Orders to burn Jorrvaskr's hounds out of their den, signed by Krev the Skinner.

underforge: Beneath the Skyforge, in a hollow of rock, Skjor waits by a stone basin. Behind him stands a great wolf with Aela's eyes.
The Circle carries a gift. Some call it a curse. Drink, and you become one of us in blood as well as name.
The blood burns. For a moment the world smells of rain and fear, and you hear every heartbeat in Whiterun.
You will hunt now, and you will never be cold again.
skjor_dead: Skjor went after the Silver Hand alone while we slept. They left him in the road like a hide on a rack.
Gallows Rock. That's where they keep their trophies. We take it apart, all of it.
kodlak_spirit: My Shield-Siblings. You have freed me from the hunt. The Wolf Spirit still holds the others; you know what must be done.
Fight it here, in Ysgramor's hall, and I will pass to Sovngarde with my head held high.
harbinger: There. Sovngarde, at last. You lead the Circle now, Harbinger. Lead it well.
Kodlak's spirit fades into the cold light of the tomb. The Companions bow their heads.

quests.title: Take Up Arms
quests.offer: I'd like to join the Companions.
quests.pitch: Join? Let me look at you. Vilkas, take our guest out to the yard and see what kind of arm they have.
quests.desc: Kodlak Whitemane, Harbinger of the Companions, is willing to consider me for a place at Jorrvaskr. First, the others want to see me fight.

objectives.text: Talk to Vilkas in the training yard
objectives.topic: Kodlak says I'm to prove myself.
objectives.reply: Fine. Not with me; I'd rather not spoil my afternoon. Go out there and put down something that deserves it, then come back.

objectives.text: Prove yourself: kill three bandits or beasts

objectives.reply: Hm. Not bad. Now take my sword to Eorlund at the Skyforge and ask him to sharpen it. Every whelp runs errands; you're a whelp.

objectives.text: Take Vilkas's sword to Eorlund at the Skyforge
objectives.topic: Vilkas asked me to bring you his sword.
objectives.reply: Of course he did. Here, take this shield to Aela while you're at it. Welcome to Jorrvaskr, whelp.
Good. You're one of us now, as far as the hall is concerned. Don't get comfortable.

quests.title: Proving Honor
quests.offer: Kodlak says you have a job for me.
quests.pitch: A scholar came to us with rumor of a fragment of Wuuthrad in Dustman's Cairn. Take Farkas. If you come back with it, we'll talk about your future.
quests.desc: Skjor sent me with Farkas to recover a fragment of Wuuthrad, Ysgramor's axe, from Dustman's Cairn.

objectives.text: Travel to Dustman's Cairn with Farkas
Fight off the Silver Hand ambush
objectives.journal: Inside the cairn the Silver Hand were waiting for us. They knew about Farkas. They called him a beast.

objectives.text: Fight through the draugr of the inner crypt

objectives.reply: So Farkas told you, and you came back anyway. Good. Tonight, the Underforge. There is more to the Companions than steel.

quests.title: The Silver Hand
quests.desc: Skjor offered me the Circle's gift: the blood of the beast. And then the Silver Hand, the hunters who track werewolves for sport, killed Skjor. Aela wants Gallows Rock burned to the ground.

objectives.text: Wait for nightfall, then go to the Underforge beneath the Skyforge

objectives.reply: Now we hunt the ones who hunt us. Skjor went after them alone and they killed him. Gallows Rock. Tonight.

objectives.text: Show Aela the Silver Hand's orders
objectives.reply: Then they died a day too early to do it. Skjor is avenged. Kodlak will want to see you; he has other things on his mind.

quests.title: Purity of Revenge
quests.offer: You wanted to see me, Harbinger?
quests.pitch: I'm old, and I want to see Sovngarde, not Hircine's hunting grounds. The witches of Glenmoril Coven gave us this blood long ago. Bring me their heads, and we can burn the beast out of me.
quests.desc: Kodlak wants to be free of the beast blood before he dies. The witches of Glenmoril Coven, who first gave the Companions their curse, hold the key to curing it.

objectives.text: Return to Kodlak with the witches' heads
objectives.topic: The witches are dead. Here are their heads.
objectives.reply: Thank you, Shield-Sibling. I can feel Sovngarde already. When my time comes, burn one in Ysgramor's tomb and take me home.

quests.title: Glory of the Dead
quests.pitch: Kodlak is dead. The Silver Hand's last raid. He wanted to be laid to rest in Ysgramor's Tomb, and free of the blood. We go north, all of us, with Wuuthrad.
quests.desc: Kodlak Whitemane died before he could be cured. The Circle carries his ashes and the restored Wuuthrad to Ysgramor's Tomb, to free his spirit from Hircine.

objectives.text: Fight through the tomb's restless guardians
Burn a witch head in the Flame of the Harbinger
Decide whether to keep the beast blood

choices.label: Kodlak was right. I want to be free of the beast too.
choices.reply: Then it's done. Burn a head for yourself, and walk out of here as you came into the world.

choices.label: The beast is part of me now. I'll keep it.
choices.reply: Your choice, Harbinger. The blood will serve you, if you master it and not the other way round.
